title: Spellbook Rule Version Index
description: Metadata stored beside a local executable rule body at ~/.spellbook/rules/<uid>/<version>/index.json.

uid.description: Backend-owned stable rule identity assigned when the draft is created.

version.description: Rule version number. Mutable until approved, immutable after approval.

applies_when.description: User-facing condition for when an agent should read and follow the rule.

trigger.description: Legacy compatibility alias for applies_when while older clients migrate.

state.description: Backend lifecycle state when known locally.

file.description: Optional local rule body filename. Defaults to SPEC.md.
